detail.longDescription: I'm building a RAG app where the model answers with citations like `[doc_3]`. Sometimes it cites a document ID that was never in the retrieved chunks — a hallucinated reference. Is there a standard way to catch this deterministically, e.g. checking every cited ID against the list of retrieved chunk IDs in code and rejecting answers with unknown IDs? Or do people normally rely on prompting the model to cite correctly?
